text:
Ben (Sales Eng): Quick kickoff note — we're starting the Amplify Health trial POC. Need to lock Day 0 agenda and success criteria. Proposed week of Apr 14-18. Main items: discovery, test prompts/evals, SSO + data residency ask, pricing guardrails. Can folks confirm availability?

Aisha (AE): I'm good for Apr 15 morning PST. Customer cares about HIPAA compliance and Dedicated capacity. They asked for cost estimate for 100k tokens/day.

Marta (Solutions): For 100k tokens/day, rough hosted cost ~ $X/day, Dedicated would need 1-2 GPUs depending on burst. We should scope eval prompts to 3 flows: clinical summarization, triage classification, and code extraction.

Jonas (Infra): For Dedicated we'd need region (us-east1) + expected QPS. Any heavy long-context cases?

Ben (Sales Eng): @Jonas they have long clinical notes up to 8k tokens, but average 1.5k. KV cache helpful for patient-level reuse. QPS ~ 2-3 rps steady with spikes to 8.

Priya (Security): We need SSO (SAML), audit log retention 1y, and KMS integration for keys. Also customer will send an external security questionnaire — can someone own it?

Aisha (AE): I'll own the questionnaire and send to Priya.

Marta (Solutions): Draft Day 0 agenda: 1) Intros + goals (10m) 2) Data & security clarifications (15m) 3) Technical discovery — model options, latency SLOs (20m) 4) Eval design — prompts + expected labels (20m) 5) Next steps + timeline (10m).

Ben (Sales Eng): Success criteria suggestion: clinical summary ROUGE >= 0.6 on curated set, triage classification F1 >= 0.85, 95th pct latency < 350ms for short prompts, <1500ms for long. Agree?

Priya (Security): Those are reasonable. Add no external PHI stored in hosted logs unless encrypted. We need contractual language for PHI handling.

Aisha (AE): Customer also asked about pricing: can we share a pilot discount and conversion credit toward Dedicated if they commit 12mo?

Ben (Sales Eng): Yes, propose 30% pilot credit; if they convert, apply credit to first 3 months of Dedicated. Need pricing approval — @finance-review?

deploy-bot: Reminder — please run the POC checklist template: /run poc-checklist Amplify-Health.

Marta (Solutions): Quick sample prompt we'll use in eval (draft):
```
Prompt: "Summarize the following clinical note and extract problem list + ICD10 codes"
Input: <clinical_note_text>
Expected: JSON {"summary": "...", "problems": ["pneumonia (J18.9)", ...]}
```

Marta (Solutions): Next actions: Aisha to send security questionnaire, Jonas to confirm region & capacity estimate, Marta to draft prompt set and baseline eval, Ben to propose trial SOW + pricing. Want to meet Tue Apr 15 10:00 PST for Day 0. :thumbsup:
